title: Roseland closes; theater tour and the cold trip to Chicago
summary: After closing at Roseland on New Year's Eve, the band toured Philadelphia, Baltimore and Washington theaters, then rode to Chicago through brutal cold, with the Grande Terrace theme song mentioned.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene
